rationale: cli/queue.py never calls session_store.writers — no orchestration_runs/loop_runs row exists for a queue entry, so the shared reader helper could never resolve a queue-side stamp. A LOOP entry it dequeues is driven via a subprocess 'll-loop run', whose own run (e.g. autodev.yaml dequeue_next) is stamped at site 1, so no issue-work path goes unstamped; SKILL/CMD/MCP/PROMPT entries are not issue orchestration and have no run row to stamp.
rule: ll-queue run is exempt from the dequeue-time SHA stamp (out of scope for ENH-2866)
alternatives_rejected: Stamping into the QueueEntry result JSON blob: unreadable by the shared reader helper, violating the single-reader AC; a first-ever direct writers call from cli/queue.py: new persistence surface for no consumer.
